name: Alternian Turnabout: Aradia Megido
storyline:
This is a Homestuck themed Ace Attorney made in Ren'py, with an emphasis on imitation and paying homage to the endearing elements of both series. The good news is that it is all but completed and ready to play thanks to the generous efforts of a supportive community, though there might still be a couple of bugs or typos hidden away. Hence why it is in beta. For those who are familiar with the webcomic, you might enjoy my humble little case. The objective should not be terribly unfamiliar to people on these boards. Someone was killed, someone innocent is suspected, and the objective is to find the truth. However, it is much easier to understand everything going on if one is familiar with the comic.

The graphics used are almost all unique, as is most of the music, however at this time most of the actual Ace Attorney sound effects and voices are still in place.
summary: Homestuck themed Ace Attorney made in Ren'py, with an emphasis on imitation and paying homage to the endearing elements of both series.
